title: There is a three-fold order, or there are three partes of the ſtudie of diuinitie.

segments.text: THE firſt is a Catecheticall inſtitution, or briefe ſumme of Chriſtian doctrine, which is called a Catechiſme, and is a briefe explication of the generall pointes of the ſame doctrine. This part is neceſſarie. For both the learned and vnlearned ought to know the foundation of religion.
The ſecond, a handling of common places, or cōmon places, which contein a larger explication of euery point, and of hard quaeſtions, together with their ſubdiuiſions, reaſons, and argumentes.

The third, a diligent meditation of the ſcripture, or holy writte. This is the higheſt degree, for which we learne all the reſt: to wit, that we may come furniſhed to the reading, vnderſtanding, and propounding of the holy Scripture. Thoſe former partes are taken out of the Scripture: and againe common places do lead vs vnto the Scripture, which is as it were a rule, by which they are directed.
